goals.title: Goals
goals.footnote: Goals are references to track your progress. There is no penalty for missing them — rest days count too.

sources.appleDescription: Reads: steps, distance, energy, heart rate, sleep. Writes: workout summaries. Sets and loads stay in the app.
sources.googleDescription: Still testing which workout types show up there. We will enable it only after confirming.
sources.miBandDescription: Provides sleep with stages and HR. Does not provide HRV or temperature.
sources.healthConnectDescription: Reads: steps, distance, energy, heart rate, sleep. Writes: workout summaries.

footnote: We tell imported, manually logged and calculated data apart. Nothing is sent to servers without your permission.

photos.privateDescription: Kept in a private backup only your account can open. They never go to friends or Apple Health. Optional reminder every 4 weeks — same time and same light make comparing easier.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.systemOff: Notifications are turned off on the iPhone.

rest.title: Rest over
rest.description: sound and vibration when the interval ends

notifications.footnote: All notifications are optional. We never send messages nagging about missed workouts.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.whereDescription: Workouts, sets and history stay on this iPhone, encrypted. With an account, an encrypted backup copy is kept.
privacy.exportDescription: everything in your account as a JSON file
privacy.disconnectHealthDescription: stops reading and writing; history stays in Tracta
privacy.deleteAccountDescription: deletes account and backup; cannot be undone
privacy.footnote: We never log health data. Deleting in Tracta does not erase what was already written to Apple Health.
privacy.exportFailed: Could not export your data. Try again.
privacy.deleteHealthDataDescription: removes sleep, steps and heart rate copied to your account; Health keeps its own
